patch.value: Sentry-injected release artifacts exceed the CI package budget because pre- and post-injection packlists share one ceiling

Release run 33882558951 passed the 20,000,000-byte package budget before publication only until Sentry injected debug IDs into the shipped JavaScript. The exact v2026.9.4 artifact then measured 20,140,358 bytes and failed, while a clean pre-injection exact-tag build measures 19,926,990 bytes. Model and gate both artifact phases explicitly so CI constrains the base package, release constrains the actual Sentry-injected package, and immutable exact-tag recovery can publish without moving the tag or weakening source-map observability.
